green.title: Green Label — The Social Sipper
green.description: You're approachable, easygoing, and always the one holding the group together. You prefer smooth, mellow pours that go down easy at a cookout or around a campfire. You value flavor without fuss and believe bourbon is best when shared with friends. Your palate gravitates toward sweeter, lighter profiles with notes of caramel, vanilla, and honey.

blue.title: Blue Label — The Refined Explorer
blue.description: Curious and cultured, you're always looking for the next great pour. You appreciate craftsmanship and love exploring how different mash bills and aging techniques shape flavor. You enjoy a well-made cocktail as much as a neat pour, and you're the one your friends come to for bottle recommendations. Your palate runs toward complex, balanced profiles with fruit, spice, and oak.

black.title: Black Label — The Purist
black.description: Intense, deliberate, and uncompromising — you know what you like and you don't apologize for it. You prefer your bourbon neat or with a single rock, and you savor every sip. You appreciate barrel-proof expressions and cask-strength character. Your palate favors bold, full-bodied profiles with deep oak, dark chocolate, leather, and tobacco notes.

red.title: Red Label — The Bold Adventurer
red.description: Life's too short for boring bourbon. You love big flavors, unexpected finishes, and bottles with a story to tell. You're drawn to limited releases, single barrels, and anything with a twist — finished in port casks, rye-heavy mash bills, or craft experiments. Your palate craves heat, spice, and the thrill of discovery.
